# Overview

This guide documents the **IRS Business Master File (BMF) Data Processing Pipeline** developed by the National Center for Charitable Statistics (NCCS) at the Urban Institute.

The BMF is the IRS's comprehensive database of tax-exempt organizations, containing information on approximately **1.9 million nonprofits** in the United States.

## What This Pipeline Does

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
    A[("IRS BMF<br/>4 Regional CSVs")] --> B["ETL Pipeline<br/>(R/data.table)"]
    B --> C[("Processed BMF<br/>Parquet")]
    B --> D[("Dimension Tables<br/>Parquet")]
```

The pipeline:

1. **Extracts** raw BMF data from the IRS website (4 regional CSV files)
2. **Transforms** 27 raw columns into ~50 standardized, validated columns
3. **Loads** processed data as Parquet files for efficient downstream analysis

## Quick Start

### Prerequisites

```r
# Required packages
install.packages(c(
  "data.table",   # High-performance data manipulation
  "arrow",        # Parquet I/O
  "stringr",      # String operations
  "lubridate",    # Date parsing
  "openxlsx",     # Excel lookup files
  "here",         # Path management
  "purrr"         # Functional programming
))
```

### Run the Pipeline

```r
# From the project root directory
source("R/00_irs_bmf.R")
```

The pipeline will:

- Download 4 regional BMF files from the IRS (~5 min)
- Run pre-transformation validation
- Execute 17 transformation functions across 10 phases
- Save checkpoints after each phase
- Generate a quality report
- Output final Parquet files to `data/processed/`

## Pipeline Outputs

| Output File | Description | Rows |
|-------------|-------------|------|
| `bmf_2025_processed.parquet` | Main fact table with all transformed columns | ~1.9M |
| `dim_activity_2025.parquet` | Activity codes dimension table | ~3M |
| `dim_classification_2025.parquet` | Classification codes dimension table | ~2M |
| `bmf_2025_quality_report.json` | Quality metrics and validation results | - |

## IRS BMF Source

The raw BMF data is published by the IRS at:
[IRS Exempt Organizations BMF Extract](https://www.irs.gov/charities-non-profits/exempt-organizations-business-master-file-extract-eo-bmf)

Field definitions are documented in the IRS Internal Revenue Manual:
[IRM 25.7.1](https://www.irs.gov/irm/part25/irm_25-007-001)

## Repository Structure

```
nccs-data-bmf/
├── R/
│   ├── 00_irs_bmf.R              # Pipeline orchestrator
│   ├── config.R                   # Configuration and paths
│   ├── input_validation.R         # Shared validation functions
│   ├── utils/                     # Logging and utilities
│   ├── quality/                   # Pre/post quality checks
│   └── [transform files]          # 17 transformation modules
├── data/
│   ├── raw/                       # Downloaded IRS files
│   ├── lookup/                    # Reference/lookup tables
│   ├── checkpoints/               # Intermediate saves
│   ├── processed/                 # Final output files
│   └── quality/                   # Quality reports
└── 00-documentation/              # This guidebook
```
